## Context

- `form::max_body_bytes()` reads `OXYROUTE_MAX_BODY_BYTES` on every body read (`src/form.rs`).
- `oxyroute_debug()` reads `OXYROUTE_DEBUG` on every 500 path (`src/dispatch.rs`).
- `once_cell` is in `Cargo.toml` but unused for runtime config.

## Problem

Per-request environment variable lookups add small but unnecessary overhead on high-RPS paths.

## Proposed change

- Cache immutable runtime flags in `OnceLock` (or equivalent) at first use.
- Document that env is read once at startup / first request, not on every call.

## Files

- `src/form.rs`, `src/dispatch.rs`
- docs: env vars section if present

## Acceptance criteria

- Defaults unchanged (`8 MiB` body cap; debug off unless `OXYROUTE_DEBUG=1`).
- Tests cover default, custom env, and `OXYROUTE_MAX_BODY_BYTES=0` (no limit).
- No per-request `std::env::var` on body read or error paths.

## Expected low-level impact

Small free win on body routes; more stable latency under load.
